0022600189.text: The Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West) visit the Pacers (3-6, 10th in the East) in the NBA Mexico City Game, a regular season contest at a neutral site in Mexico City where Denver is the designated road team. Denver enters on a one-game win streak and is 2-1 on the road, while Indiana is also riding a one-game win streak but is 0-4 at home this season. Julian Strawther is out for the Nuggets with a knee sprain, and Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Denver won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 135-120 win in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
